👋 Hi, I’m Dev Tiwari, a B.V.Sc & A.H(Pursuing) MRCVS & RC and DVLT (LUVAS), sharing expert knowledge on veterinary science. My channel features content on veterinary education, student life, vlogs, and course-related insights.

😊About me-
▪️2019-2021 Batch Vet Lab Technologist from LUVAS Hisar, Haryana 
▪️One year as a Senior Technician in Vet Lab 
▪️2022, BVSc & AH(Pursuing) MRCVS & RC
▪️India’s Top Veterinary Course Counsellor🏆 
▪️Career Coaching Certification in Career Development Coaching🏆

❤️On this channel, you’ll find:
✅ Veterinary Education & Career Guidance
✅ BVSc, VLDA & Veterinary Admissions Updates
✅ College Reviews & Counselling Support
✅ Veterinary Student Life & Vlogs
✅ NEET & Veterinary Career Opportunities
✅ Practical Tips, Motivation & Study Guidance
✅ Animal Health Awareness & Veterinary Knowledge

📞 For admission and counselling: +91 8901539404, +91 7027001356

📧 For promotions or collaborations:
drdevtiwariyt@gmail.com

Thank you for your support!
